Finance Officer Job at SLOT Systems Limited




        
    

        
        SLOT Systems Limited is the leading retail company for affordable and durable mobile phones, computers, accessories, and various types of home appliances. Over the years, we have been the first to announce and introduce new Brands, and Services such as Mobile Phone Engineering Services, Phone Screen Insurance, Phone Trade-In, a Stolen Phone Recovery App, and much more.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Finance Officer
Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Process financial transactions and maintain accurate financial records.
	Prepare payment schedules, reconciliations, and financial reports.
	Support accounts payable and receivable processes.
	Ensure compliance with company financial policies and procedures.
	Assist with budgeting, statutory remittances, and month-end closing activities.
	Liaise with internal departments to ensure timely financial reporting.


Requirements


	Possess a B.Sc. / HND in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline with 3 - 5 years of experience.
	Relevant accounting or finance experience is an added advantage.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
	Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
	High level of integrity, accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their application and updated CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Warehouse Operator",
  "description": "Zipline - Do you want to change the world? Zipline uses drones to deliver critical and life-saving medicine to thousands of hospitals serving millions of people in multiple countries. Our mission is to provide every human on Earth with instant access to vital medical supplies. Join Zipline and help us make this a reality for billions of people.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Warehouse Operator

Job Location: Yenagoa, Bayelsa

About you and the Role&nbsp;&nbsp;


	The Warehouse Operator will be a member of the Fulfillment Operations team, executing several tasks related to but not limited to the preparation of life-saving packages meant for delivery to Zipline&rsquo;s customers.
	These responsibilities encompass picking and packing orders, conducting cycle counts, completing checklists, and ensuring the overall organization and cleanliness of the warehouse.
	This role demands attention to detail, adherence to safety protocols and standard operating procedures, as well as the ability to perform repetitive tasks accurately and efficiently.


Key Responsibilities
Inventory Receipt, Storage, and Audits:


	Accurately receive inventory into the Zipline inventory management software system.
	Utilize inventory management systems to track and record all movements of goods.
	Ensure the received inventory is stored properly within the required storage locations and conditions (temperature requirements).
	Assist in the periodic completion of Stock audits and audit reconciliations.


Picking and Packing:


	Accurately pick products from storage based on incoming orders

Warehouse Operator Job at Zipline




        
    

        
        Zipline - Do you want to change the world? Zipline uses drones to deliver critical and life-saving medicine to thousands of hospitals serving millions of people in multiple countries. Our mission is to provide every human on Earth with instant access to vital medical supplies. Join Zipline and help us make this a reality for billions of people.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Warehouse Operator

Job Location: Yenagoa, Bayelsa

About you and the Role  
     

            
    




	The Warehouse Operator will be a member of the Fulfillment Operations team, executing several tasks related to but not limited to the preparation of life-saving packages meant for delivery to Zipline’s customers.
	These responsibilities encompass picking and packing orders, conducting cycle counts, completing checklists, and ensuring the overall organization and cleanliness of the warehouse.
	This role demands attention to detail, adherence to safety protocols and standard operating procedures, as well as the ability to perform repetitive tasks accurately and efficiently.


Key Responsibilities
Inventory Receipt, Storage, and Audits:


	Accurately receive inventory into the Zipline inventory management software system.
	Utilize inventory management systems to track and record all movements of goods.
	Ensure the received inventory is stored properly within the required storage locations and conditions (temperature requirements).
	Assist in the periodic completion of Stock audits and audit reconciliations.


Picking and Packing:


	Accurately pick products from storage based on incoming orders
	Pack and label picked orders accurately ensuring items are securely packaged while following the standard operating procedures
	Perform quality checks on items picked and packed to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and customer requirements.


General Warehouse Cleanliness and Safety:


	Maintain a clean and organized work environment, adhering to safety and hygiene protocols.
	Complete Accurately, routine checklists for operations.
	Ensure compliance with company policies and safety regulations.


Communication and Collaboration:


	Collaborate closely with specialist ops, flight ops, and customer care teams to coordinate daily operations and prioritize tasks.
	Communicate effectively with team members and supervisors regarding operational issues and opportunities for improvement.
	Support other warehouse functions and team members as required. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and team meetings.


Required Qualifications


	OND/HND & or Fresh graduate Biology, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Agricultural Science, Microbiology, Medical Lab Tech, Community, Pharmacy Technician, Purchasing and Supply Chain or a related field is a plus.
	Experience: 0-2 years of experience in a warehouse or similar environment preferred.


Key Competencies:


	Strong attention to detail and accuracy in performing repetitive tasks.
	Ability to work efficiently both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
	Computer literacy.
	Efficiency in written and spoken communication.
	Proficiency in using inventory management software and handheld devices for order processing.
	Excellent organizational and time management skills.
	Commitment to maintaining a safe working environment and following safety guidelines.
	Reliable and flexible to work occasional overtime and weekends as needed.
	Committed to living the Zipline values: Ownership, Transparency, Customer Obsession, Servant leadership & Continuous improvement.


Working Conditions:


	Environment: Warehouse environment with exposure to varying temperatures and noise levels.
	Physical Demands: Requires standing, walking, and lifting products and objects regularly.
	Schedule: Full-time position, may require overtime and weekend work.

General Manager Job at Radisson Hotel Group




        
    

        
        Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest and most dynamic hotel groups with seven distinctive hotel brands with more than 1,100 hotels in destinations around the world. Our portfolio of hotel brands includes: Radisson Collection, Radisson Blu, Radisson, Radisson RED, Park Plaza, Park Inn by Radisson and Country Inn & Suites by Radisson.

Radisson Hotels’ highest priority is the health, safety & security of our guests, employees and business partners worldwide.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: General Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are currently seeking a General Manager to join our vibrant team at the Radisson Blu Hotel Ikeja, Nigeria. 
	At RHG, we are in search of individuals who go beyond the resume – those with character, skills, talents, and a passion for creating memorable experiences.  We value mindset as pivotal: anticipating guest needs, supporting your department, and consistently delivering memorable experiences.
	As a General Manager you are responsible for leading and supporting your team on a daily base and ensure the successful operation of the hotel. You will be the representative person of our RHG brand by delivering memorable moments to our guests and team.


Responsibilities
You will:


	Be responsible for the P&L of the hotel and oversee the daily operations.
	Plan and supervise the activities of an extensive and diverse workforce, to ensure the smooth and profitable running of the business.
	Be a strong and professional business leader, ensuring that hotel team members work as a well-functioning team.
	Operate the hotel in a manner that represents the brand standards and exceed guest expectations.
	Responsible for actively communicating and executing the company strategies.
	Play a key role between the central team and the owners


Qualifications


	As a General Manager at Radisson Hotel Group, you are the orchestrator of exceptional experiences.
	Your role goes beyond executing the master plan; it's about balancing strategic focus on guest experience, revenue generation, and achieving commercial results.  


Our General Managers enjoy the challenge of running our show. It’s what makes your heartbeat faster!  


	You have experience in hotel management or in a related field. 
	You have excellent communication and interpersonal abilities. 
	You are a strategic thinker, problem-solving skills and passionate for hospitality 
	You will balance executing and delivering the master plan with a strategic focus on guest experience, revenue generation and achieving commercial results for our stakeholders. 
	You will work with Heads of Department to maximize business opportunities and brand reputation, as well as ensuring adherence to legislation, due diligence requirements and managing the hotel budget. 
	Reporting to the District Director Nigeria and/or Managing Director Sub Sahara Africa.  


We are looking for: 


	Flexibility and a positive, Yes I Can! Attitude  
	An eye for detail  
	Is a creative problem-solver  
	Passionate about creating extraordinary service 
	Ability to work as part of a team to ensure guest satisfaction 
	Strong verbal communication skills  
	Likes having fun at work  
	Experience in a similar position is beneficial but not essential  
	Languages: English 
	MICE and sales experience within the Nigerian market 
	Experience in a resort is a plus
